title: Returned-Wire Refund Amount and Lost Days for Closing and Funding Closings
content:
**Formal clause.** A returned-wire refund returns the prepaid interest a funded Closing and Funding closing collected for the lost days of a Larkspur-side return, the days the loan went unfunded because Larkspur's own wire came back. For a returned-wire refund, the charge collected at closing is the closing's prepaid interest charge booked on the signing date, and lost days are counted only within that charge's period. A returned-wire refund counts lost days only between a first lost day and a last lost day; without both there are no lost days and the refund is zero. Each lost day is refunded at the daily amount the charge collected at closing used. The returned-wire refund is the lost days times that daily amount, rounded half up to the cent.

**The return looked at.** The return a returned-wire refund looks at is the closing's latest wire return; it is Larkspur-side when the settlement agent rejected a wire whose amount differs from the amount of the wire that funded the loan (Larkspur's wrong amount) or when Larkspur recalled the wire because a prior-to-funding item was open.

**Lost days.** The lost days run from the first lost day through the last lost day, both counted, cut back to the last day of the charge collected at closing, and are never fewer than zero. A first lost day that falls before the charge's first day is counted from the charge's first day.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Charge collected at closing: the 24th through the 31st, daily amount 60.27. First lost day the 26th; last lost day the 29th.

- Lost days: the 26th through the 29th, both counted: 4.
- Refund: 4 times 60.27, which is 241.08.

| Variation (hypothetical) | Lost days | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| last lost day the 2nd of the next month | cut back to the 31st: the 26th through the 31st, 6 | 361.62 |
| first lost day the 22nd, last lost day the 29th | counted from the 24th: 6 | 361.62 |
| no last lost day | none | 0.00 |
